subject: unexpected money
caption: Nobody thinks they'd be the spender until the money is actually in the account.

beats.text: You get ten thousand dollars you didn't plan for. There are four reactions, and they're all about what you think you deserve.
It's already spent before it lands. That was the point of it.
It goes somewhere safe and you never think about it again.
You ask what it could become in five years.
You leave it sitting there, because deciding feels dangerous.
A windfall doesn't change your money habits. It just makes them louder.
Follow for the stuff nobody teaches you.
